title: Investors become richer by ₹34.61 trillion as Sensex surges in November
description:
Equity markets have rallied sharply this month, with the BSE Sensex climbing nearly 11 per cent, making equity investors richer by Rs 34.61 lakh crore amid strong foreign fund inflows, lower crude oil prices, better-than-expected Q2 earnings and a global sell-off in AI-linked stocks.
The 30-share BSE benchmark Sensex jumped 7,976.46 points, or 10.71 per cent till November 23.
Following the bullish trend in equities, the market capitalisation of BSE-listed companies has surged by Rs 34.61 lakh crore to Rs 5,08,98,444.87 crore (USD 5.48 trillion) this month.
Foreign investors have emerged as a major driver behind markets rally, with net investments crossing the Rs 1 lakh crore mark to reach Rs 1.27 lakh crore in November so far, marking the highest-ever monthly inflow.
The strong inflows come after Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) withdrew Rs 34,843 crore in October and Rs 35,861 crore in September, according to data available with the NSDL.
